# Space Dudz

Product key: space-dudz
Canonical product: https://spacedudz.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/space-dudz/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/space-dudz/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- shop retro space streetwear
- find psychedelic space graphic tees
- buy space hoodies or apparel
- shop space gifts and accessories
- find kids space clothes from Baby-Rangers

## Authority

public storefront and catalog discovery with human-confirmed checkout; fulfillment begins only after authoritative payment confirmation and order review

## Commercial state

- Status: source_commerce_wired
- Offer: Live storefront catalog
- Pricing: Varies by current product and variant
- Payment state: Source includes Stripe checkout, webhook, order authorization and capture functions; completed payment and order state must be provider-verified

## Boundaries

- live storefront product price, availability, variant and shipping terms are authoritative at purchase time
- checkout creation or authorization alone is not proof of a completed order
- launch orders are manually reviewed and handed off for fulfillment after payment
- current checkout accepts US shipping addresses
- private checkout, order, payment and customer data remain outside public discovery

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
